WITH mv AS (
  SELECT `Campaign Objective` AS objective, MEASURE(`Average CPM`) AS mv_avg_cpm, MEASURE(`Impressions Delivered`) AS impressions
  FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.ad_delivery_metrics GROUP BY ALL),
raw AS (
  SELECT c.campaign_type AS objective, AVG(d.cpm_realized) AS avg_cpm_realized,
         SUM(d.revenue_amount)*1000/SUM(d.total_impressions_served) AS dashboard_cpm
  FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery d
  JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.campaign c ON d.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.campaign_type),
tgt AS (
  SELECT campaign_type AS objective, AVG(target_cpm) AS avg_target_cpm, COUNT(*) AS campaigns
  FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.campaign GROUP BY campaign_type)
SELECT COALESCE(mv.objective, raw.objective) AS objective, ROUND(mv.mv_avg_cpm,2) AS average_cpm, mv.impressions,
       ROUND(raw.avg_cpm_realized,2) AS avg_cpm_check, ROUND(raw.dashboard_cpm,2) AS dashboard_cpm,
       ROUND(tgt.avg_target_cpm,2) AS avg_target_cpm, tgt.campaigns
FROM mv FULL JOIN raw ON mv.objective = raw.objective
LEFT JOIN tgt ON tgt.objective = COALESCE(mv.objective, raw.objective)
ORDER BY average_cpm DESC

WITH t AS (
  SELECT `title_id`, `name`, `season_number`, `content_type` FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`title` WHERE `name` = 'Ashen Tempest'
), v AS (
  SELECT t.`title_id`, s.`territory_id`, COUNT(*) AS sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT p.`subscriber_id`) AS viewers,
         MIN(p.`session_start_timestamp`) AS first_view, MAX(p.`session_start_timestamp`) AS last_view
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` p
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`content_episode` e ON p.`content_episode_id` = e.`content_episode_id`
  JOIN t ON e.`title_id` = t.`title_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber` s ON p.`subscriber_id` = s.`subscriber_id`
  GROUP BY t.`title_id`, s.`territory_id`
), w AS (
  SELECT `title_id`, `territory_id`,
         MAX(CASE WHEN `active_flag` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_active,
         COUNT(*) AS windows,
         MIN(`window_open_date`) AS first_open, MAX(`window_close_date`) AS last_close,
         CONCAT_WS(', ', COLLECT_SET(`availability_status`)) AS statuses
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`content_window`
  WHERE `title_id` IN (SELECT `title_id` FROM t)
  GROUP BY `title_id`, `territory_id`
)
SELECT t.`season_number`, tr.`name` AS territory, tr.`territory_group`, v.sessions, v.viewers,
       CAST(v.first_view AS DATE) AS first_view, CAST(v.last_view AS DATE) AS last_view,
       COALESCE(w.windows,0) AS windows, w.first_open, w.last_close, w.statuses,
       CASE WHEN w.has_active = 1 THEN 'Active' WHEN w.windows IS NULL THEN 'No window ever' ELSE 'Not active' END AS window_status
FROM v JOIN t ON v.`title_id` = t.`title_id`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`territory` tr ON v.`territory_id` = tr.`territory_id`
LEFT JOIN w ON v.`title_id` = w.`title_id` AND v.`territory_id` = w.`territory_id`
ORDER BY t.`season_number`, CASE WHEN w.has_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, v.sessions DESC
